🌼💕 MEET DAISY! 💕🌼
🐶 Female | 11 weeks old | Pittie Mix
Look at that smile! 😍 Daisy is one seriously happy little girl—and she has plenty to smile about now that she's ready to find her forever family!
At just 11 weeks old, Daisy is an absolute lovebug. She's sweet, affectionate, playful and great with other dogs. ❤️🐾
💕 Very lovable & sweet
🐶 Great with other dogs
🎾 Loves to play
🥰 Affectionate little sweetheart
🦸‍♀️ Certified SUPER PUP!
